title: RepoList
description: Repositories of the index, sorted by slug.

ContextAssignment.description:
The context of a repository and the rule that chose it, first match wins:
override, host, path, default context, otherwise unassigned.

oneOf.description: `[repos."<path>"] context` names the context of this repository.
An entry of `match.hosts` matches the host and path of the primary remote.

pattern.description: The matching entry, `host` or `host/path-prefix`, as normalized.

oneOf.description: An entry of `match.paths` is the longest prefix of the repository path.

prefix.description: The matching entry, as written in the configuration (before `~` expansion).

oneOf.description: No rule matches and no `default_context` is set.

ContextName.description: Context name: 1 to 64 lowercase ASCII letters, digits and `-`, starting with a letter, not ending with `-`.

MaybeKnown_Nullable_RepoOperation.description:
A state field that may not have been computed: the time budget ran out, or it could not
be read (the reason is in [`RepoState::error`]).

Serialized as `{"known": <value>}` or `"unknown"`, so that a known `null` (no upstream, no
operation…) is never confused with an unknown value.

location.description: Normalized location; absent for a local path or a URL loom cannot read.

url.description: URL as configured, without any password.

RemoteUrl.description:
Network location of a remote, normalized: host lowercased (SSH aliases resolved), user,
default port and `.git` suffix removed, path case kept.

path.description: Path without leading or trailing `/` and without `.git`, such as `gsuquet/loom`.

port.description: Port, when not the default of the transport.

oneOf.description: A branch with at least one commit.

name.description: Short branch name, such as `main` or `feat/x`.

oneOf.description: A branch without any commit yet (new repository, orphan branch).

commit.description: Abbreviated commit id (`core.abbrev`, at least 7 hexadecimal digits).

RepoOperation.description: A git operation left in progress in the working tree.

oneOf.description: `git am`: patches being applied from a mailbox.

RepoState.description: The state of a repository, read without starting git, at [`RepoState::refreshed_at`].

default_branch.description:
Default branch: the target of `refs/remotes/<primary remote>/HEAD`, otherwise `main`,
otherwise `master` when the branch exists; `null` when none of them.

dirty.description:
Tracked paths with a change: modified, staged, deleted, renamed or conflicted
(untracked files are counted in `untracked`).

error.description: Why some fields are unknown, in English; `null` when every field is known.

last_commit.description: Committer date of `HEAD`'s commit, `null` for an unborn branch.

last_fetch.description: Modification time of `FETCH_HEAD`, `null` when the repository was never fetched.

upstream.description:
Upstream of the `HEAD` branch, `null` when detached, unconfigured, or when its ref is
missing (never fetched, or deleted on the remote and pruned).

RepoSummary.description: A repository of the index: its identity and how loom knows it.

context.description: Context and the rule that assigned it.

forge.description: Forge of the primary remote's host, when known.

last_used.description:
Last time the repository was used (`loom repo show`, or a `loom` command run inside
it), when known.

path.description: Absolute path, as found (symbolic links kept). The key of a repository.

primary_remote.description: Name of the primary remote: `origin`, otherwise the first one.

registered.description: Added by `POST /v1/repos/register`: a scan never removes it while it exists on disk.

slug.description:
`<context>/<name>`, with a numeric suffix (`-2`, `-3`…) when another repository has the
same one. `unassigned/<name>` for an unassigned repository.

state.description: State (the repo card), `null` until it is read for the first time.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC with whole seconds, such as 2026-10-12T08:00:00Z.

Untracked.description: Untracked files of the working tree, `.gitignore` applied.

capped.description: The count stopped at the cap: there are more.

count.description:
Number of untracked files (an untracked nested repository counts as one), at most the
cap.

Upstream.description: The upstream of the branch `HEAD` is on.

ahead.description: Commits of `HEAD` that are not in the upstream.

behind.description: Commits of the upstream that are not in `HEAD`.

name.description: Short name of the upstream ref, such as `origin/main`.
